title.vi: Quy tắc Kiểm soát thực vật (Nhà phân tích được ủy quyền)
title.th: กฎการควบคุมพืช (นักวิเคราะห์ที่ได้รับอนุญาต)
title.ms: Kaedah Kawalan Tumbuhan (Penganalisis yang Diberi Kuasa)

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Control of Plants (Authorised Analysts) Rules.

2. For the purposes of section 3(3) of the Act, the prescribed qualification of an authorised analyst is a tertiary qualification in biology, microbiology, chemistry, toxicology, biotechnology, food technology, food science, nutrition, horticulture, veterinary medicine or such other science as may be approved by the Minister.
[G.N. No. S 8/99]
[S 220/2019 wef 01/04/2019]
